propositions: completion_verifier reads pinned ticket snapshot from stale local mirror (refs/heads/tickets) instead of live tracker HEAD, causing snapshot to lag origin/tickets by thousands of commits

close_precheck calls verifier with fetch=False which skips network reconvergence and pins stale local branch; verifier's show_ticket then sees outdated ticket state while model receives fresh context from live store

non-PASS verdicts with empty findings are coerced to FAIL with synthesized placeholder criterion (unspecified) instead of reporting verdict_obtainable=false; verifier cannot distinguish "no verdict obtained" from "verdict obtained but no findings"
materialize_tickets must pin ticket store at live tracker HEAD by resolving SHA from tracker repo when present, not from stale local mirror, to ensure snapshot is current-at-close by construction
